Taunt.text: This card must be attacked before all other non-taunt targets if possible.

Silence.text: The specified card's ability cannot be used.

Neutralise.text: Send the specified card(s) to the neutralised pile.
notes: Neutralising does not count as destroying or discarding.

Helidrop.text: This card can attack in the same turn it is played.

Retreat.text: Send the specified card(s) on field to their owner's hand.

Rescue.text: Choose a card of the specified type in the deck, reveal it to your opponent, then move it to your hand.
notes: Rescuing does not count as drawing the card.

Remember.text: Choose a card of the specified type in your graveyard, reveal it to your opponent, then move it to your hand.
notes: Remember does not count as drawing the card.

Equip.text: Choose a friendly operator and attach it underneath this card. The stats, abilities and attack status of both cards are combined.
notes: Equipping from the field does not count as playing the card, so an Instant effect will not activate again.

Hovering.text: Can only be attacked by, and can only block medium and long ranged cards and other cards with hovering.

Summon.text: Move the specified cards from the extra deck to the field in the order they are stated on the card. If there is not enough space on the field, add them to the hand.

Obtain.text: Move the specified cards from the extra deck to your hand.

Intrepid.text: Whenever there are less friendly cards than enemy cards on the field, this card has +2 ATK, +2 DEF and its countdown cannot decrease.
notes: Intrepid is a passive effect that can be lost and gained depending on the board state.

Overwhelm.text: When this card wins in battle, deal any excess ATK as damage to your opponent.
notes: Overwhelm damage is always calculated using the attacker's attacking stat, so if your card is attacking with DEF or something else, that stat is used instead.

Sleeping.text: Sleeping cards cannot attack or defend, their abilities are disabled, they cannot be targeted and their countdowns do not decrease at the end of the turn. Sleeping cards are considered inactive.
notes: Lasts until specified in the card effect, or until the card inflicting sleep is destroyed.
Sleeping cards can still be affected by non-targeting and AOE effects, and still count for 'number of cards' effects.

Auto.text: Specify a time or condition and activate every time that condition is met.
notes: These can activate on your opponent's turn if the condition is satisfied.

Manual.text: This ability can be used at any time during the turn you play this card or the ability is gained. If the ability is not used, it is disabled at the end of the current turn. Manual abilities can only be used once per deployment of the card.

Passive.text: Apply their effects continuously, either for a set duration or until the card is destroyed, whichever comes first.

Instant.text: This ability must be used immediately as the card is played.

Active.text: Can be used once per turn, with no limit on how many times they may be used per game. Commonly found on Locations, but may exist on other cards.

React.text: Can be used once per deployment when an enemy uses a Manual, Instant, Active or React ability, or when an enemy attacks.
notes: Reacts cannot be used from the hand, but can be triggered on any player's turn and can only target the enemy that triggered the react.
React chains are always resolved in the reverse order the abilities were activated.

Short range.text: Can only attack player HP if there are no blocking enemies.

Medium range.text: Can attack player HP regardless of blocking but their final ATK is halved (rounded up).

Long range.text: Can attack player HP regardless of blocking.

Countdown.text: Certain cards have a duration, usually found in the bottom right of the card. It decreases by 1 at the end of the controlling player's turn. When it reaches 0, the card is considered to have 'expired' and it is sent to the graveyard.
notes: Sleeping cards' countdowns do not decrease at the end of the turn.

Unaffected.text: All effects of that type may still target, choose or otherwise reference the card, but any abilities that change the attributes, cost, stats, abilities, countdowns, positions, names, or states of the card are ignored.

Refresh.text: Refreshed abilities can be used again. Only Manual, Active and Instant abilities can be refreshed.
notes: Manual and Active abilities may be used at any time during the turn they are refreshed, whereas Instant abilities must be used immediately upon being refreshed.
